title: Red Ponchos gathering at Chonchocoro during a visit by European lawmakers
reason: The Jan. 4 Los Tiempos issue describes a group reacting to a foreign parliamentary visit, but gives no attendance estimate and no clear demand directed at Bolivian government policy. It is excluded from January candidate events pending domestic-state-target and 50-person evidence. The reported violence is not assigned to any other candidate.
notes: The Jan. 4 issue date is not verified as the gathering date. Attendance and a domestic policy target remain unresolved; preserve the source’s visit context and do not assign its violence report to another candidate.
